The board is covered with letters, the chalk strokes careful. In the lower corner, a hasty line: “Nhài is very good.”

Dải vải đỏ mới buộc, chưa bạc màu. Người: A red strip newly tied, not yet faded. Their families have not forgotten, or someone still changes the cloth each year.
Hoa nhài trắng muốt giữa đất ẩm. Mùi thơ: Jasmine, white as snow, in the damp earth. A soft, sorrowful scent. Someone tends them; they could not grow this fair on their own.

A bundle of dried herbs hangs there: mugwort, betel leaf. Mrs. Tám's, I am sure. She doctored the whole household.
